messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Elevated gateway 504 rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (5m avg: 7.2% -> baseline 0.3%). Paging oncall.

maya (oncall): seeing the same on dashboards. latency spike ~1.2s then 504s. starting triage. @sam you around?

sam: on it. quick glance — increase in backend timeouts from model-proxy layer. traces are sparse tho, only ~10% sampled. :confused:

rachel: did a deploy go out recently? I saw a small model-proxy tweak 18m ago (deploy 2026-03-15T14:12) but not sure if related.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T14:12 completed to prod (rev: model-proxy-v2.1.3) by @tony. No rollbacks.

tony: that change tightened circuit-breaker thresholds in proxy to fail fast. I can revert if we want, but let's confirm root cause first.

maya (oncall): customer impact: support-ops reports ~150 affected requests/min from a handful of high-traffic tenants — error spikes biggest on long prompts and embedding routes. assigning P1. Notifications going out.

support-ops: posting to customers now. SLA hit likely for some enterprise customers. ETA for mitigation?

sam: issue: our traces don't show proxy -> serving handoff for most failures because sampling config was recently lowered to 5% in us-west for perf. we need higher fidelity fast.

rachel: we should enable temporary trace sampling and add a lightweight log in the proxy to capture request_id + route + upstream latency. low-risk change.

tony: I can flip trace sampling to 50% and add a 1-line debug log to ingress config. patch and rollout will be quick. Would prefer not to revert immediately.

maya (oncall): do it. document steps here. also add fallback routing to dedicated-pool for traffic over threshold.

sam: actionable checklist:
- flip sampling: `kubectl set env deployment/proxy PROXY_TRACE_SAMPLING=0.5 -n prod`
- add debug log to configmap: `ingress: extra_log: "req_id=%s route=%s upstream_ms=%d"`
- enable routing rule: `traffic-router promote --from=hosted --to=dedicated-pool --route=/v1/generate --threshold=20` (tony)

tony: running trace sampling change now.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: proxy-config-hotpatch-20260315 (1/3 pods). Logs will appear in /var/log/proxy.

maya (oncall): while that's rolling, can we throttle long prompts or reject >X tokens temporarily?

sam: quick hotfix: add limiter on prompt length at the gateway (max_tokens=4096). Patching LUA rule.

tony: applied limiter on 2/3 gateways. one pod still terming out but patch will reach it. seeing drop in SLO-violating requests.

rachel: sampling is up and we now have better traces. grabbing a few failing traces — root cause looks like proxy circuit opened when backend spike increased p99 latency; but many traces lack request_id because the ingress wasn't logging it earlier.

sam: new traces show a tail of retries from clients hitting the proxy, causing extra load and cascading timeouts. also some 502->504 conversion in gateway.

maya (oncall): routing fallback to dedicated-pool now? status?

tony: promoted ~30% of traffic for /v1/generate to dedicated-pool. initial metrics: errors drop from 7.2% -> 2.1% on promoted shard.

support-ops: customers notified that we have partial mitigation; working on full rollback plan.

sam: still seeing some 504s from edge due to missing request_id in logs — can't correlate all failures. we added a temporary header `X-RI-Req` at the proxy to carry a generated UUID. patch in configmap below:
```
- name: add-req-header
  lua: |
    function handle_request()
      local reqid = ngx.var.http_x_request_id or uuid.generate()
      ngx.req.set_header("X-RI-Req", reqid)
    end
```

rachel: good. that header will help stitching logs/traces until we restore full tracing.

maya (oncall): customer impact update for exec: "We observed elevated 504s for generation endpoints in us-west starting ~14:05 UTC. Partial mitigation routed traffic to dedicated capacity reducing errors by ~70% for routed traffic. We are collecting traces and adding temporary logs; working on full rollback of the proxy circuit change. ETA 60-90m."

tony: starting rollback plan for model-proxy-v2.1.2 (previous). I'll stage it to canary 5% first, monitor latency/5xx.

deploy-bot: Rollout: model-proxy-v2.1.2 -> canary (5%).

sam: monitoring — can we keep trace sampling and extra logs until this is fully resolved? also need to revert sampling back after incident.

maya (oncall): yes keep them. action items (post-incident):
- revert sampling to baseline (rachel)
- add permanent request_id propagation in ingress (engineering)
- add playbook step to route to dedicated-pool automatically on X% errors (sre)
- evaluate circuit-breaker defaults and add unit tests (infra)

rachel: noted. I'll own the sampling revert and write the postmortem stub.

support-ops: updated customers; offering credits where SLA breached. keeping ticket open.

tony: canary looks fine at 5%. increasing to 25% now.

maya (oncall): good. once canary stable, do full rollback. we will keep incident channel open until errors <0.5% for 30m.

sam: current metrics: global /v1/generate errors 2.4% (was 7.2). us-west down to 1.1% due to routing fallback. We'll keep an eye on retries and p99.

rachel: writing the incident timeline now. will include the temporary instrumentation snippets and recommended durable fixes.

maya (oncall): thanks everyone. assigning followups in the incident board. marking this channel as active incident until full recovery confirmed. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status update: mitigated -> monitoring. Next update in 30m or on new developments.
